title: Shima Enaga 3D
summary: 一个完全零资源的交互式3D鸟类宏观观察体验，封装在单一HTML文件中。世界内含超过15867根实例化的3D曲线多瓣羽毛，每根羽毛由多达111069个细小羽支组成，层叠于16层天鹅绒般的绒毛底层，呈现无缝圆润轮廓。环境包括金色阳光照射下有晶莹的雪覆盖的庭院、折射的玻璃温室、樱花盛开、体积光和飘雪效果。支持无碰撞穿越开启的天窗飞行，有缓慢多角度宏观镜头轨道、锐利的景深散景效果。音效由Web Audio API实时合成，包括鸟鸣、翅膀拍打及温室混响。完全由Three.js、自定义GLSL和Web Audio API通过纯数学程序生成，无任何外部模型、贴图或音频文件。
summary_en: A fully zero-asset interactive 3D macro bird-watching experience packed into a single HTML file. It features over 15,867 instanced 3D curved multi-barb feather plumes (111,069 individual barbs) layered over 16 velvety down undercoat shells forming a seamless round silhouette. The environment includes a golden-hour snowy yard, refractive glass greenhouse, blooming sakura, volumetric sunbeams, and exterior falling snow. The bird autonomously flies collision-free through an open skylight with slow multi-angle macro camera orbits and sharp macro depth of field bokeh. Real-time procedural audio synthesis generates bird trills, wing beats, and greenhouse reverb. Everything is procedurally generated by Three.js, custom GLSL shaders, and Web Audio API from pure mathematics with no external 3D models, textures or audio files.
workflow_steps_en: Design procedural algorithm for instanced multi-barb feather plumes and smooth down undercoat | Develop custom GLSL shaders for feather rendering with specular and subsurface effects | Create procedural environment with snowy terrain, refractive glass greenhouse, sakura blossoms, sunbeams, and snow particles | Implement autonomous bird flight state machine with collision-free routing through skylight opening | Set up multi-pass WebGL2 rendering pipeline for refraction, depth textures, bloom, and macro depth of field postprocessing | Synthesize real-time procedural bird chirps, wing beats, ambient soundscape, and convolution reverb with Web Audio API | Integrate camera controls and hidden control panel with various toggles | Package entire experience into a single self-contained HTML file with no external dependencies
tech_stack: WebGL2 | JavaScript | HTML | GLSL | Web Audio API
workflow_steps: 设计多瓣羽毛实例和绒毛底层的程序算法 | 编写自定义GLSL羽毛渲染着色器，包含高光和次表面散射 | 程序生成雪地、折射玻璃温室、樱花、体积光和雪花效果环境 | 实现鸟类自主飞行状态机和无碰撞天窗穿越路由 | 搭建多通道WebGL2渲染流水线，支持折射、深度纹理、泛光和宏景深后处理 | 用Web Audio API实时合成鸟鸣、翅膀声、环境声和混响 | 集成摄像机控制与隐藏控制面板提供多功能开关 | 打包为单文件HTML，无任何外部依赖
skills_or_prompts_used: Three.js图形库使用 | GLSL自定义着色器编写 | Web Audio实时声音合成 | WebGL2多通道渲染 | 复杂几何实例化与程序生成 | 交互式摄像机控制设计
evidence_quotes: Not a single texture, 3d model, or mp3 in this video. | just ONE html file(644kb) and pure math. | built with antigravity + Gemini 4 NEON /swarm. | 15,867 3d feather plumes (111k barbs) in custom glsl | three.js refractive glass, god rays & macro bokeh | web audio api synthesizing every chirp, wingbeat & room reverb in real time | A zero-asset, interactive 3D macro bird-watching experience packed into a single self-contained HTML file (`index.html`).
